tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & E-Commerce Expert | Java & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering / IT.

cover_en.subject: Application: Solution Architect - E-Commerce / Shopify / Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Solution Architect role at ABRIO GmbH, bringing over 5 years of solid backend and e-commerce platform engineering experience. My background includes building, extending, and supporting enterprise platforms for global brands such as Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: APIs and Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Reviews
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues, and provided technical guidance to junior developers while working within agile international teams.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, ensuring high performance and stability.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is rooted in Java and SAP Commerce Cloud rather than Shopify, I have strong experience in complex application and integration architectures and am very keen to learn and expand into new e-commerce ecosystems.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical background aligns with your engineering standards.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Solution Architect - E-Commerce / Shopify / Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für den Solution Architect bei ABRIO GmbH gelesen. Als erfahrene Backend-Entwicklerin bringe ich über 5 Jahre fundierte Praxis in der Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Plattformen für Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell mit.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud unter Einsatz von Java und Spring.

bullets.label: APIs und Datenintegration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Konzeption und Optimierung von Datapipelines zwischen PIM- und E-Commerce-Systemen.

bullets.label: Qualität und Code Reviews
bullets.text: Durchführung von Code Reviews, Unterstützung bei der Fehlerbehebung im Betrieb und technische Anleitung von Nachwuchsentwicklern.

bullets.label: Performance-Optimierung
bullets.text: Führung von Datenbankabfrage-Refaktorisierungen zur Reduzierung der Antwortlatenz und Steigerung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit.

cover_de.gap: Da mein bisheriger Schwerpunkt auf SAP Commerce Cloud und Java liegt, bringe ich Shopify-Erfahrung derzeit noch nicht mit, bin jedoch hochmotiviert, mich in diesen Bereich einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026. Mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join ABRIO GmbH because of your position as a leading Shopify partner and fast-growing e-commerce consultancy working with diverse clients from startups to large enterprises. I am drawn to your dynamic environment, focus on modern technologies, and commitment to personal growth and high engineering standards.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend expertise, API integration skills, and technical leadership experience to help scale robust commerce platforms at ABRIO GmbH.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your Solution Architect opening at ABRIO GmbH. With 5+ years of backend e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, building scalable APIs and integrating platforms, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your engineering standards.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Solution Architect position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical foundations in integrations, performance tuning, and agile teamwork. 

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
